lcc_original: 天地與其萬彙【1】都造齊了。
notes: 與其 ('and their') has no dedicated SN in UNV — left unannotated; these correspond to Hebrew prefixed conjunctions and the pronominal suffix on צְבָאָם
LCC 萬彙 corresponds to UNV 萬物, both translating H6635 (צָבָא 'host')
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position after the SN tag on 萬彙
